name: Resolve demonstrable experience gaps against market evidence

userStory.actor: a professional planning how to build market-relevant experience
userStory.intent: compare admitted candidate evidence with evidence-backed market signals
userStory.outcome: inspect the market-relevant experience the candidate cannot yet demonstrate

experience.actor: a professional planning how to build market-relevant experience
experience.promise: I can see market-relevant experience I cannot yet demonstrate.

observableConditions.statement: each unsupported market signal is visible as an experience acquisition opportunity
each opportunity retains the market evidence facts supporting its demand signal
supported signals identify the admitted candidate evidence that demonstrates them
